question: Select the correct option related to the function regulated by ovaries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Menstrual cycle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ovaries are responsible for producing hormones such as estrogen and progesterone, which are crucial for regulating the menstrual cycle.
 
• These hormones control the development and release of eggs (oocytes) from the ovaries during the menstrual cycle.
 
• The menstrual cycle is typically around 28 days long but can vary from person to person.
 
• The cycle consists of four main phases: menstruation, the follicular phase, ovulation, and the luteal phase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Estrogen:** A hormone produced by the ovaries that plays a key role in the development of female secondary sexual characteristics and the regulation of the menstrual cycle.
 
• **Progesterone:** A hormone released by the corpus luteum in the ovary that prepares the endometrium for pregnancy if fertilization occurs.
 
• **Ovulation:** The process by which an ovary releases a mature egg into the fallopian tube, usually occurring around the midpoint of the menstrual cycle.
 
• **Menstruation:** The shedding of the uterine lining, resulting in bleeding, which marks the start of a new menstrual cycle.
 
• **Follicular Phase:** The phase of the menstrual cycle during which follicles in the ovary mature, ending with ovulation.
